scope: One authorized feature extension on all848unblindeddevelopment cases; grouped CV diagnostic only, no new independent validation.
group_folds: Exactly the original434connected groups/fivefolds; no regrouping or outcome-based resampling.
window_mapping: Current shallow before.current/after.current; prior shallow before.previous/after.previous (terminal after uses current), matched to exact same strong baseline case and FENs. Missing roots never invented.
limits: One feature-set extension; no depth/threshold grid, model selection, new engine calls, browser calls or further expansion.
rank_AUC: Descriptive current-window weak_minus_strong_loss_pp among cases passing both hard eligibility masks; expected direction larger=>Brilliant, no threshold fitting.

inspiration.paper: Predicting User Perception of Move Brilliance in Chess
inspiration.interpretation: Weaker-engine disagreement was associated with perceived human brilliance in that study, not proof of Chess.com classification criteria or this node-budget proxy.
